description: About The Team We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision. This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you. What You Will Do Revenue & P&L Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers Marketing, Growth & Campaigns Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions Platform Health & Fulfilment Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures Analytics & Reporting Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions Who We Are Looking For Must Have Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)] 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment Good to Have Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation What We Offer Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom
title: Growth Manager – Content & Local Brand

description: The Mission Every attack runs on internet infrastructure, and DomainTools maps that infrastructure better than anyone. For over 25 years, elite security teams have used DomainTools to spot malicious infrastructure before it's used against them. Today we're in an active growth phase{{:}} shipping new products, expanding our intelligence platform beyond its DNS roots, and building for AI-native security operations. Our platform covers domains, IPs, hostnames, SSL certificates, passive DNS, real-time threat feeds, and AI-native integrations, with visibility into 97% of the internet. Iris, DNSDB, our real-time feeds, and our new MCP Server power security teams at Fortune 500 companies, U.S. federal agencies, and leading SOCs. We're not chasing a category. We define it, and we're accelerating. The Opportunity DomainTools is at an inflection point{{:}} strong product-market fit, a fast-expanding platform, and a market moving toward AI-native security operations. We're building a demand engine to match, and growth marketing is how we find and scale the levers that make it work. This is a hands-on builder role. You'll run experiments across the website, paid channels, and the full funnel, from first visit to qualified opportunity, and double down on what works. You'll prove impact in conversion rates, efficient acquisition, and pipeline, not vanity metrics. You'll report to the Director of Demand Generation and partner closely with Product Marketing, Product, Sales, and RevOps. If you want to own real numbers at a company that's genuinely in motion, this is your role. What You'll Own Experimentation and Funnel Growth Growth experiment roadmap{{:}} Generate, prioritize, and run tests across the funnel, from first visit to qualified opportunity, and share learnings with the team. Free-to-paid and expansion{{:}} Build lifecycle and nurture programs that move free users, trial users, and existing customers toward purchase and expansion. Website, Digital, and Search Website as a conversion engine{{:}} Optimize landing pages, forms, CTAs, and user journeys; run A/B and multivariate tests to lift conversion rates. Paid acquisition{{:}} Manage and optimize paid search, paid social (especially LinkedIn), and retargeting to lower cost per opportunity. Organic growth{{:}} Partner with Content on SEO strategy, keyword targeting, and technical SEO fixes that grow high-intent traffic. AI and MarTech, With Discipline AI-assisted workflows{{:}} Build AI-assisted and agentic workflows for personalization, content variants, and experiment velocity. Analytics and Cross-Functional Partnership Measure everything{{:}} Own funnel analytics and dashboards with RevOps, improve attribution, and turn data into clear recommendations. Partner across GTM{{:}} Work with Product Marketing on positioning tests, Product on in-app growth loops, and Sales on lead quality. Requirements Must-haves{{:}} 4-7 years of B2B growth, performance, or demand generation marketing, ideally in SaaS or cybersecurity A track record of experiments that measurably improved conversion, acquisition cost, or pipeline Hands-on experience with paid search and paid social, including budget management and bid optimization Website and CRO experience{{:}} landing page testing, analytics setup, and tools like Google Analytics, Optimizely, VWO, or similar Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals Hands-on Marketo experience{{:}} building programs, smart campaigns, lead scoring, nurture flows, and reporting, plus working fluency with Salesforce Strong analytical skills{{:}} you can build funnel reports, read attribution, and size an opportunity Clear writing and the ability to test messaging with a technical audience Strong plus{{:}} Product-led growth experience{{:}} free tiers, trials, or self-serve funnels Familiarity with threat intelligence, SecOps, or the security analyst workflow SQL or experience working directly with product usage data Experience with ABM or intent data platforms (6sense, Demandbase, or similar) Experience building AI-assisted or agentic marketing workflows Compensation{{:}} $90K - $125K base salary, plus a 10% annual bonus Benefits DomainTools is the global leader for Internet intelligence and the first place security practitioners go when they need to know. The world's most advanced security teams use our solutions to identify external risks, investigate threats, and proactively protect their organizations in a constantly evolving threat landscape. DomainTools constantly monitors the Internet and brings together the most comprehensive and trusted domain website and DNS data to provide immediate context and machine-learning driven risk analytics delivered in near real-time. DomainTools offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees that includes fully paid medical, dental and vision insurance premiums, a 401k retirement plan with company matching, basic life insurance, flexible PTO and additional well-being benefits. DomainTools embraces diversity, equity and inclusion to its fullest as an equal opportunity employer. We build our teams so creativity and innovation can flourish. We believe inclusivity and equity fosters innovation and growth, and we harness this mindset to drive a culture that serves our employees and our customers. We encourage people of all backgrounds, ages, perspectives and skill sets to apply; and do not discriminate based on age, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.
title: Growth Marketing Manager

description: Job Description Murphy deploys AI agents for banks starting with the most straightforward business case: voice AI for debt collection . We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication. Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and SMS to maximize results while preserving trust. We’re live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We’ve proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks. And now we need to move fast to secure leadership in this $300Bn+ industry . About The Role We're looking for a Data Analyst to turn every transaction into the reliable analytics. You'll work directly with the co-founders and will own the metrics, models and dashboards behind every decision we make. What you'll do Own the numbers. Define the KPIs every team runs on, and make sure everyone calculates them the same way. Build the source of truth. Write the data models and dashboards that turn raw call, debt and payment data into answers people trust. Automate invoicing. Turn billing every bank, in every currency, into a pipeline that runs itself. Prove what works. Design and read the experiments that tell a real lift in recovery from noise. Dive deep and problem solve. Get to the root cause of every number that looks off, and fix it at the source. Who you are Highly analytical, and precise. You've built metrics and models a business actually ran on. You're fluent in SQL and Python. You own outcomes, and you never settle. You don't stop at the chart — you chase the number until it changes a decision. You have a STEM degree, and you were top of your class. You're technical, you're rigorous with numbers, and you have a strong philosophy of a champion. AI-native, ruthless on quality. You reach for AI to automate and streamline by default. You know exactly where it gets sloppy. You never let that through, and you control quality rigorously. You don't need a collections or fintech background. We'd rather teach the domain to a killer than hire a lifer who can't ship — you'll pick up the data, the domain and the regulation cold, fast. 🤝 What we offer 📈 Fair equity with enormous upside potential. 💰 Salary at the top of the benchmark . 🧩 Real ownership — Murphy's numbers are yours to define and defend. ⛳️ Small team, high autonomy, and outsized impact. 👏🏻 The founding team's direct attention, and a category with a $300B+ industry behind it. 🛜 Hybrid & Flexible : Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office. Our Process We believe that hiring is a two-way street: while we get to know you, you also deserve the chance to understand who we are, how we work, and what makes Murphy AI special. Here’s what you can expect: 1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange. 2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role. 3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises. 4️⃣ Coffee at the Office with the Founders Finally, you’ll join us in our Barcelona office for a relaxed coffee with the founders and the Hiring Manager. It’s the perfect opportunity to experience our culture firsthand and meet more of the team who could soon be your colleagues. 👉 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected. Job Details Role Level: Not Applicable Work Type: Full-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: https://www.getmurphy.ai Job Function: Data Science & AI Company Industry/ Sector: Other What We Offer About The Company Searching, interviewing and hiring are all part of the professional life. The TALENTMATE Portal idea is to fill and help professionals doing one of them by bringing together the requisites under One Roof. Whether you're hunting for your Next Job Opportunity or Looking for Potential Employers, we're here to lend you a Helping Hand. Report Disclaimer: talentmate.com is only a platform to bring jobseekers & employers together. Applicants are advised to research the bonafides of the prospective employer independently. We do NOT endorse any requests for money payments and strictly advice against sharing personal or bank related information. We also recommend you visit Security Advice for more information. If you suspect any fraud or malpractice, email us at abuse@talentmate.com.

description: Heb jij ervaring als Product Owner, klopt jouw hart sneller voor de zorg én krijg je energie van slimme ICT-oplossingen? HealthConnected groeit! Wil jij de regie nemen over ons Huisartseninformatiesysteem (HIS) en meebouwen aan innovaties zoals AI-toepassingen en het FHIR-koppelvlak? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Alkmaar / Hybride (minimaal 3 dagen op kantoor) | HBO/WO | 32 - 40 uur Over HealthConnected Bij HealthConnected geloven we dat zorgverleners hun tijd moeten kunnen besteden aan wat er echt toe doet: de patiënt. Daarom ontwikkelen wij hét ICT-platform voor de eerstelijnszorg. Onze basis bestaat uit geavanceerde communicatie-, verwijs- en consultatiemogelijkheden, aangevuld met Elektronisch Patiënten Dossier (EPD) en Huisartseninformatiesysteem (HIS) functionaliteiten op maat. Onze software is gebruiksvriendelijk, flexibel, modulair en voldoet altijd aan de actuele wet- en regelgeving. Samen met een enthousiast en gedreven team werken we dagelijks aan software waar zorgverleners én patiënten écht blij van worden. Wat ga je doen? In deze rol ben je overzichtelijk, doortastend en koersvast. Als Product Owner ben je inhoudelijk én strategisch de drijvende kracht achter de doorontwikkeling van ons Huisartseninformatiesysteem (HIS) . Je richt je op het bouwen van nieuwe core-features van het HIS en het realiseren van naadloze integraties met externe systemen, zoals patiëntportalen en medische meetapparatuur. Je bent de steun en toeverlaat voor je Scrum-teams en het centrale aanspreekpunt voor de inhoudelijke kwaliteit van het product. De belangrijkste uitdagingen en taken in jouw rol: Innovatie met het FHIR-koppelvlak: Je leidt de uitrol en doorontwikkeling van ons FHIR-koppelvlak. Hiermee maken we het doeltreffend en eenvoudig om veel sneller nieuwe integraties met externe partijen op te leveren — iets waar onze klanten én partners heel blij van worden. Slimme AI-integraties: Je verkent én realiseert de integratie van innovatieve AI-functionaliteiten binnen ons systeem om de administratieve druk bij huisartsen merkbaar te verlagen. Kwaliteit, Privacy & Certificering: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de certificering van de applicatie en de organisatie. Je bewaakt de prestatiekenmerken, zorgt voor de implementatie van relevante zorgstandaarden en neemt actief deel aan privacy- en informatiebeveiligingsprocessen (zoals het IBMF en risicomanagement). Koers houden & Roadmap: Je stelt de product-roadmap op, prioriteert de backlog en vertaalt klanteisen, marktvragen en wet- en regelgeving door naar concrete user stories. Stakeholdermanagement: Je vormt de verbindende schakel tussen de interne organisatie (Product Manager, Designer, Business Developers, Teamleiders en Directie) en externe stakeholders. Waar kom je in terecht? Je komt te werken in een open, dynamische en informele werkomgeving met korte lijnen richting de directie. Binnen onze productorganisatie werk je intensief samen met de Product Manager en onze UI/UX Designer. Voor de realisatie stuur je inhoudelijk twee vaste Scrum-teams aan: Team 1: 2 Back-end Developers, 1 Quality Engineer en jij als PO. Team 2: 2 Back-end Developers, 1 Quality Engineer en jij als PO. Samenwerken en sparren op kantoor is essentieel voor de verbinding met het team en de operatie. Je bent daarom minimaal 3 dagen per week aanwezig op ons kantoor in Alkmaar , gecombineerd met de flexibiliteit om vanuit huis te werken. Wat breng jij mee? We zoeken een Product Owner die makkelijk schakelt tussen inhoudelijke details en het grote plaatje (de helikopterview). Je bent communicatief sterk, nauwkeurig en in staat om draagvlak te creëren bij uiteenlopende belangen. Opleiding & Ervaring: HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau met minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare ervaring als Product Owner . Methodiek: Grondige kennis van en ervaring met Agile en Scrum. Sterke Pré’s: Een pre-technische achtergrond, ervaring als (voormalig) developer of sterke Business Analyse-skills. Dit helpt je enorm bij het doorgronden van FHIR-koppelvlakken en AI-toepassingen. Domeinkennis: Ervaring met certificeringstrajecten en zorgstandaarden binnen de zorg-ICT is een grote plus. Eigenschappen: Je bent kritisch, gestructureerd, kwaliteitsgericht en beschikt over de nodige organisatiesensitiviteit en overtuigingskracht. Privacy & Security: Een actieve en positieve instelling ten aanzien van informatiebeveiliging, privacy en patiëntveiligheid. Wat mag je van ons verwachten? Wij geloven dat talent de ruimte en ondersteuning nodig heeft om het product en de organisatie verder te brengen: Dienstverband: Een uitdagende functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week. Salaris: Tussen de € 5.500,- en € 6.100,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur). Innovatieve Omgeving: Werken met vooruitstrevende technologieën zoals AI-toepassingen en FHIR-standaarden. Impact & Groei: Een sleutelrol waarin je direct bouwt aan de digitalisering van de zorg en de schaalbaarheid van ons HIS-platform. Fijne Werkomgeving: Een gedreven, deskundig en leergierig team om mee samen te werken binnen een prettige cultuur. Hybride Werken: Werken op kantoor in Alkmaar (minimaal 3 dagen) met de mogelijkheid om ook vanuit huis effectief te werken. Is dit jouw nieuwe uitdaging? Herken jij jezelf in dit profiel en wil je samen met ons bouwen aan de toekomst van de eerstelijnszorg? We maken heel graag kennis met je! Stuur je CV en motivatie naar ons toe, dan nemen we zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.
title: Product Owner (HIS & Zorg-ICT)

description: TITLE: Product Owner, Platform DEPARTMENT: Product REPORTING TO: Director, Product Management OFFICE LOCATION: London, UK ROLE TYPE: Hybrid, Full-time IPC is a global fintech company that puts people at the center of innovation. With a strong global footprint, we empower financial institutions and capital markets with advanced cloud-based trading communications and managed connectivity solutions. Through our portfolio of communications and connectivity solutions, we focus on solving business challenges and adapting to regulatory changes in the fast-paced global financial markets. This enables our clients to maintain consistent market access, a strong competitive advantage, and enhanced operational efficiency. Join a team that is dedicated to delivering groundbreaking products and making a significant impact on our clients' success. www.IPC.com ­­­­­­­ Overview of the Team The team consists of three Product Owners reporting to the Director of Product Management based in Paris, France. This role will work closely with global stakeholders across Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams, supporting a highly collaborative and distributed operating model. Role Overview: The Product Owner, Platform will own and prioritize the platform roadmap that enables the successful delivery of IPC's strategic product portfolio. Acting as the bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, this role will translate platform strategy into actionable product requirements and measurable outcomes. The successful candidate will work closely with distributed engineering teams, architects, and operational stakeholders to deliver platform capabilities that improve reliability, scalability, security, and speed of innovation. This role requires strong product ownership skills, technical fluency, and the ability to balance customer, business, and engineering priorities in a fast-paced fintech environment. Key Responsibilities: Own and manage the platform product backlog to ensure alignment with business priorities and strategic objectives. Define and communicate product requirements, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable successful execution. Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to prioritize platform investments that improve scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency. Collaborate with Product Managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic initiatives into platform capabilities. Drive roadmap planning and release prioritization based on business value, customer impact, and technical dependencies. Analyze platform performance metrics and user feedback to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Support delivery teams throughout the Agile development lifecycle, ensuring requirements are clear and actionable. Work closely with Security, Compliance, and Operations teams to support platform governance and risk-management objectives. Facilitate stakeholder alignment across multiple functions and geographies. Contribute to the evolution of platform standards, best practices, and product management disciplines. How You Will Make an Impact: Accelerate delivery of strategic platform capabilities that support IPC's product portfolio. Improve engineering efficiency through clear prioritization and well-defined requirements. Drive enhancements in platform reliability, scalability, availability, and operational excellence. Enable faster product innovation through reusable platform services and capabilities. Improve stakeholder satisfaction through transparent roadmap planning and execution. Support the continued modernization of IPC's technology ecosystem. Contribute to measurable improvements in platform adoption, quality, and business outcomes. Essential Skills and Experience to be Successful in this Role: 2-5 years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, or a related platform-focused role. Proven experience managing product backlogs and delivering products within Agile and Scrum environments. Strong understanding of cloud platforms, platform services, APIs, and modern software delivery practices. Experience partnering closely with engineering and architecture teams on technical products. Ability to define user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable product outcomes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision making. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences. Experience prioritizing competing initiatives and managing dependencies across multiple teams. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or related field. Fluent English communication skills. Desired Skills and Experience: Experience in fintech, capital markets, financial services, SaaS, or regulated technology environments. Knowledge of cloud-native architectures and platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Experience with observability, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or platform engineering concepts. Familiarity with trading communications, connectivity services, or mission-critical enterprise platforms. Experience with API platforms, developer platforms, or integration ecosystems. Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), or similar certification. Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones. Understanding of regulatory and compliance considerations relevant to financial markets. What’s in It for You? At IPC, your compensation is only part of the package. We are committed to investing in a range of programs and initiatives to improve the overall experience of our employees. In addition to a collaborative, high-performing team environment, we’re pleased to offer benefits including: Competitive Base Salaries Private Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance and Optical Reimbursement Salary Sacrifice Pension Scheme 25 Holidays per Year Plus Public Holidays Additional Time off for Charity Work and Volunteering Tuition Reimbursement Certification Bonus Program Access to “IPC University” our Internal E-Learning Platform Enhanced Parental Leave Wellness Program Fitness Membership Cycle to Work Scheme Season Ticket Loan Employee Referral Scheme Further information about your benefits will be provided during your onboarding process. Additional Information: At IPC, we believe that hybrid working creates an inclusive, flexible environment where employees can perform at their best, and teams can collaborate, innovate, and celebrate successes together. We spend around 60% of our time in the office and around 40% of our time working remotely. Some employees may be required to work from the office or client sites more than 60% of the time, if required by their role and/or client needs. Your precise work schedule will be determined by you and your Line Manager before commencement of employment with IPC. You can explore more about our culture, offerings and commitment on www.ipc.com/careers/ and www.ipc.com/about-us/about-ipc/ . IPC’s Work Culture: The IPC work culture is one that fosters inclusion, prioritizes innovation, and maximizes potential. We are a global ecosystem, full of diverse people that together made IPC what it is today. Our strength as an organization is the sum of our different backgrounds, perspectives, skills and geographies; supported by an ironclad commitment to constructive dialogue and open-mindedness. We live and breathe our commitment to innovation by embracing bold ideas, seizing new opportunities and striving for excellence. Our people have continued to deliver ground-breaking solutions to our clients for over 50 years
title: Product Owner, Platform

description: Department: Transformation Location: UK - London Description As CFC continues to grow globally, we’re looking for an experienced Business Analyst to help shape and deliver strategic change across the business. You’ll work on a varied portfolio of initiatives spanning business transformation, operational improvement and regulatory change, partnering with stakeholders across areas such as underwriting, claims, operations, finance and compliance. This is a highly business-facing role where you’ll get under the skin of complex problems, challenge assumptions and help turn business needs into practical solutions that deliver measurable results. You’ll work closely with Project Managers, Product Owners, SMEs and delivery teams, helping ensure we’re solving the right problems rather than simply jumping to solutions. About the role Partner with stakeholders to understand business challenges, strategic objectives and opportunities for improvement. Lead workshops, interviews and discovery sessions to define problems, requirements, outcomes and success measures. Analyse existing processes, operating models and business capabilities, identifying opportunities to simplify and improve the way we work. Translate complex business needs into clear requirements, user stories, process maps and acceptance criteria. Design future-state processes and solutions, considering impacts across people, process, technology, data and controls. Challenge assumptions and provide evidence-based recommendations to support effective decision-making. Act as a key link between business stakeholders, Project Managers and delivery teams throughout the change lifecycle. Support solution evaluation, testing, UAT, business readiness and the successful adoption of new ways of working. Help measure the impact and benefits of change while contributing to the continued development of our Business Analysis capability. About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

About the role: This role defines product strategy and drives business growth by translating market and stakeholder needs into actionable priorities. The Product Manager identifies growth opportunities through adoption analysis, assesses product potential, and develops commercial strategies, including pricing and offering tiers. The role oversees the product lifecycle—from roadmap prioritization and development tracking to launch and post-launch feedback—while connecting stakeholders, engineering, sales, marketing, and customer success. It also monitors competitors and market trends to identify opportunities for differentiation.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Product Strategy & Business Case

• Define the product vision, strategy, and value proposition aligned to business objectives.

• Build business cases covering market opportunity, customer need, competitive positioning, revenue potential, investment, and ROI.

• Develop financial models, pricing scenarios, and commercialization strategies.

• Present investment recommendations to leadership; track market trends and emerging technology to drive innovation.

2. Pricing & Commercial Strategy

• Define pricing, packaging, and monetization models; benchmark against competitive pricing.

• Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and business leaders to optimize commercial models.

• Monitor profitability, ARR, margin, adoption, and customer lifetime value, and recommend pricing adjustments.

3. Roadmap & Prioritization

• Own and maintain the product roadmap; translate opportunities into initiatives, epics, and releases.

• Facilitate prioritization workshops balancing customer need, business value, technical feasibility, and strategy.

• Apply prioritization frameworks based on ROI, customer impact, and market demand.

• Drive alignment across engineering, UX, customer success, sales, and executive stakeholders.

4. Requirements Management

• Gather, analyze, and document business and customer requirements.

• Author PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional/non-functional specifications.

• Work with UX and Engineering to refine solutions and validate technical feasibility.

• Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and product reviews.

5. Launch & Adoption

• Define launch, enablement, and adoption strategies; execute go-to-market plans with Marketing and Sales.

• Drive onboarding, customer training, and customer success initiatives.

• Track adoption, usage, engagement, retention, and revenue performance.

• Identify adoption barriers, act on post-release feedback, and improve value realization.

6. Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership

• Act as the primary point of contact for product decisions across internal and external stakeholders.

• Facilitate consensus and decision-making across diverse groups.

• Report roadmap progress, product performance, risks, and opportunities; influence strategy with data-driven recommendations.

7. Performance & Analytics

• Define and track product KPIs and success metrics.

• Measure adoption, retention, revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and ROI.

• Maintain executive dashboards and lead periodic product performance reviews.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical, or Computer Science; or an MBA with specialization in Product Management.

• 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or Product Strategy roles.

• Demonstrated experience across business case development, pricing and commercialization, roadmap management, requirements documentation, and go-to-market execution.

• Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

• Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum product development methodologies.

• Strong analytical, financial modelling, and problem-solving capability.

• Experience with SaaS, digital, or platform products and subscription-based business models.

• Exposure to product analytics tooling and data-driven decision-making.

• Experience managing products across multiple markets, segments, or channel partners.
